newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: OUB Bank links to Mastercard's ATM net.
newsitem.headline: OUB Bank links to Mastercard's ATM net.

text.p: Overseas Union bank Ltd (OUB) said on Thursday it would be the first Singapore bank to introduce a global automatic teller machine (ATM) card for point-of-sale purchases and cash advances.
From November 4, OUB's new Global Autocash Card would allow customers access to Mastercard International's global Maestro and Cirrus network, OUB said in a statement.
Maestro has 600,000 point-of-sale shops and other establishments worldwide. Cirrus has some 300,000 ATMs in some 88 countries, it said.
Mastercard International, based in the United States, is an association 22,000 member financial institutions.
